subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new cost-currency surface, and if so should it live on provider/model pricing metadata or as a global display preference?
rationale: The current contract names cost values as USD, and changing the label affects user trust, mixed-provider sessions, docs, config shape, and UI/CLI/status output rather than a single formatter.

options.title: Design currency metadata first
options.body: Add a canonical currency contract to pricing metadata and update all cost renderers only after the owner boundary, validation, docs, and migration behavior are decided.

options.title: Keep USD-only accounting
options.body: Leave cost estimates as USD and document that users should convert non-USD provider rates before entering them.

options.title: Add display-only preference
options.body: Add a global symbol preference for ergonomics while explicitly accepting that it may not represent mixed-provider accounting.

recommendation.title: Design currency metadata first
recommendation.body: Add a canonical currency contract to pricing metadata and update all cost renderers only after the owner boundary, validation, docs, and migration behavior are decided.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the original usage cost reporting path and recent Control UI provider-cost display work, so he is the strongest available routing candidate for the product choice.
